strengths.point: Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.
strengths.evidence: Operating profit 48 Cr vs interest 1 Cr = 48x cover (TTM)

strengths.point: The sales trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
The reserves trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
Return on capital has improved over recent years.

weaknesses.point: Cash conversion is poor - very little profit reaches operating cash flow.

Operating margin has compressed over the last few years.
Receivables tie up a lot of cash.
Margins contracted in the latest quarter.

weaknesses.point: Profit slipped versus the previous quarter.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

threats.point: Management stated that 30% of their total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted force majeure until declared by the government two weeks ago.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management mentioned a prolonged monsoon affecting Construction Chemicals activity, which later picked up post monsoon.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)
